name: Grade
desc: The colourist's pass — the whole frame is re-inked through a film process using separable blend ops that keep luminosity intact: sodium-vapour monochrome, day-for-night, two-strip Technicolor or a punched-up Velvia transparency, finished with a turning graduated ND filter, a drifting power window and a lamp density that never sits perfectly still.

energy.doc: grade strength — how far the frame travels toward the stock

contrast.doc: print contrast: 0.5 neutral, above crushes into the stock, below lifts the blacks milky

density.doc: power window — a soft drifting pool of exposure and its roll-off

grad.doc: graduated ND filter — warm lift one side, cool density the other, axis turning

scale.doc: size of the power window and the grad falloff

hue.doc: the stock's ink (34 = sodium amber); every style derives its cast from it

x.doc: power-window centre x (it wanders around this)

alpha.doc: master opacity of the whole pass
